claims.rationale: The colchicine contraindication covers all protease inhibitors except fosamprenavir in renal or hepatic impairment and reports life-threatening and fatal toxicity; atazanavir is a protease inhibitor.
The FAERS disproportionality abstract reports the strongest ROR signal for colchicine plus atazanavir and rhabdomyolysis/myopathy (ROR 35.4), and the claim frames it as a reporting signal.
